text_post: An adaptation of the classic Barney Stinson; "Hey, have you met Ted?", then walk off after setting up your wing (Ted in this case). "Hey, have you met Ted? He likes bacon" then walk off to go to the bar/toilet/anywhere out of sight. Walking away is optional but generates additional WTF factor that is so huge that a bitch shield won't even register it! Amazingly, this worked every time last night. After opening 3 or 4 sets, it became clear that this opener also had something special about it; if the girl said that she didn't like bacon, you hadn't wasted your time getting to know her before being told that she didn't like bacon. Let's be honest here, who likes a girl that doesn't like bacon?
